guide_changes.title: Library-wide Changes: CSS classes applied to components use the mat-mdc- prefix, whereas before it was simply a mat- prefix
Library-wide Changes: The styles associated with the mat-typography class are no longer generated automatically
Theming: Default typography levels defined by mat.define-typography-config have been updated to reflect changes to the Material
Card: By default, mat-card does not apply any internal padding
Card: <mat-card-content> no longer sets any typography styles, users are free to add whatever typography styles make sense f
Chips: The migration tool always changes the legacy <mat-chip-list> to <mat-chip-listbox> to minimize differences before an
Dialog: The .mat-dialog-container does not contain a 24px padding anymore
Dialog: mat-dialog-content uses the font-settings specified by the Material Design spec, which includes a rather roomy line-he
Form Field: The text inside <mat-hint> is larger and darker in order to meet W3C text guidelines
Input: MatInput must be inside <mat-form-field>
Paginator: The form-field inside of mat-paginator only supports the appearance options offered by the new form-field (fill an
Slider: The slider template API has changed from a single <mat-slider> element to a <mat-slider> element which contains one
Slider: The new discrete property on the <mat-slider> now controls whether the slider has tick marks and a value indicator t
Slider: To accommodate range sliders, the implementation has changed from the <mat-slider> element being the form control to t
Snack Bar: For simple snack-bars with an action button, they use the MDC-based mat-button, so your application will need to include
Table: Flex tables (<mat-table>) display a border on the cells instead of rows
Table: Flex table (<mat-table>) row height is set with height instead of min-height
Tabs: The <mat-tab-nav-bar> requires a reference to a <mat-tab-nav-panel> using the tabPanel input

traps.title: define-legacy-typography-config becomes define-typography-config
Typography classes take the 2018 names (mat-headline -> mat-headline-5, mat-title -> mat-headline-6, ...)
mat-card gets appearance="outlined" to keep the legacy outlined look
A read-only mat-chip-list becomes mat-chip-listbox with mat-chip-option
